name: Carlo
description: A cadet from Kroog's River Wards, promoted to pilot, who is badly burned and killed by Fallaji crossbowmen.

description_citations.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Doug answers Carlo's question: the creative team does not address planeswalkers' language barrier, since explaining it would cause more problems.
timeline.quote: we don't address it, as fun as it would be to go into the language problem once or twice, because over the long haul the cure would be worse than the disease.

citation.work: Six Ways to Fail at Creative Endeavors
citation.text: "Six Ways to Fail at Creative Endeavors". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tawnos promotes the five cadets to full pilots and briefs them on the Mardun crossing and Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: The first waves of Mishra's force have crossed the Mardun; they control the River Wards.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The pilots and their avengers push through burning streets, past bodies, to a plaza held by Yotian soldiers under Lieutenant Markos.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fallaji troops attack the plaza barricade, and Llora orders Sanwell, Rica and Carlo to flank the dragon engine.
timeline.quote: Find a way to flank the engine and bring it down, pilot!

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Sanwell and Rica drag a screaming Carlo away and reach a crossroads plaza, wondering where to run.
timeline.quote: Like Tawnos told us—if we're in danger, we run.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji explode Sword Two's powerstone, burning Carlo and wounding Sanwell and Rica.
timeline.quote: The brasscaps detonated their bomb lances and killed Sword Two.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fallaji crossbowmen kill the crawling Carlo as Sanwell and Rica hide.
timeline.quote: A flurry of crossbow bolts thudded into Carlo's back, killing him.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.
